title: The Last City on Earth
author: E. J. Caldwell
description: High above the ruins of an ancient world, the glittering spires of humanity's final stronghold stand against cosmic threats. Explore themes of survival, futuristic architecture, and resilience in this gripping upper-intermediate sci-fi novel.
whatYouWillLearn: Expand your B2-level vocabulary with specialized futuristic and scientific terms, master complex clause connectors, and practice reading natural dialogues in futuristic settings.

B2: High above the ruins of the ancient world stood the glittering spires of the last city on Earth.
In this upper-intermediate science fiction novel by E. J. Caldwell, humanity defends its final stronghold against the unknown depths of space.
